hints.title: Sort Covered Intervals
hints.text: Sort all intervals by their starting boundary so covered segments can be examined in ascending order.

hints.title: Track Next Available Point
hints.text: Maintain a pointer indicating the next uncovered coordinate, initially set to 0.

hints.title: Uncovered Gap Extraction
hints.text: Whenever an interval begins after the pointer, the range between the pointer and interval start minus one is an uncovered gap.

hints.title: Interval Gap Sweeping Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting ranges followed by single forward scan.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Marking individual coordinates in an array takes O(n) which exceeds memory limits for n = 10^9.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Avoids coordinate explosion by processing intervals directly after sorting.
